claims.body: The Hurricanes shoot a lot, and the Flyers are one of the league’s worst at keeping shots down. Look for a big shot total.

claims.gist: The Hurricanes shoot a lot, and the Flyers give up plenty.

claims.body: Almost nobody punishes turnovers like the Flyers, and the Hurricanes give the puck away in bad spots.

notes.text: S. Jarvis is on the injured non-roster list and has not played this season. He is a top-six forward. W. Carrier has taken his spot beside S. Aho and A. Svechnikov.

PHI.head: Philadelphia faces a real test
PHI.body: Carolina has controlled the play far better over recent games, Carolina will be without Jarvis, and Philadelphia has home ice. Philadelphia can pull it off if they pounce on loose pucks.

CAR.head: The matchup suits Carolina
CAR.body: Carolina has controlled the play far better over recent games, Carolina will be without Jarvis, and Philadelphia has home ice. Philadelphia’s way back in is pouncing on loose pucks.

story.head: Round two in Philadelphia
paras: The Hurricanes already came to Philadelphia once this season and left with a 3-2 overtime win. The Flyers haven’t won in six. The Hurricanes have won four straight.
The Hurricanes shoot a lot, and the Flyers give up plenty. Expect plenty of hitting.
